about: Documents' tools for agents (through Agent Link): name, what it does, its arguments as JSON Schema, its group, whether it changes the document.

drawing_make.description: A drawing of bodies as a normal TechDraw page, editable in TechDraw (its template and title block, its views, section and dimensions), laid out in one call: standard views (front, top, right, iso by default; back, bottom, left too), first-angle (ISO) or third-angle (ASME) projection, at the largest standard scale that fits A4 or A3 (paper auto picks A3 only when it allows a bigger scale), overall sizes dimensioned once each (dimensions: false leaves them off), hidden: true dashes the hidden edges. Exports SVG, PDF and DXF to the output folder: the page's own TechDraw exports where TechDraw can write them (PDF and SVG need FreeCAD's window), Workshop's sheet writer for the rest (filesFrom says which); page: false writes the files only. dims adds feature dimensions with tolerances or ISO 286 fits (limits written in), holes calls out every round hole by size, titleBlock fills the template's title block. section: a straight view drawn as a full section (cut square to it through the middle, sectionAt mm towards the viewer; the cut faces hatched, the cutting line lettered sectionLabel, A, in a view that sees it edge on) — for bores, pockets and walls inside.

bodies.description: Bodies to draw; all when left out.

scale.description: 0.5 for 1:2, 2 for 2:1; left out, the largest standard one that fits.

file.description: Where the files go: a name (in the session's folder), or a path — absolute (its folder made) or under the session's folder; an extension given is dropped, and the PDF, SVG and DXF share the stem.

dims.description: Feature dimensions: [{ view, kind: length (a, b, along h|v, offset mm) | diameter | radius (a round edge), fit "H7" or plus/minus mm, label }]; a and b a point [x,y,z] or a query { body, kind, type, radius, near } (a circle's centre, an edge's middle).

holes.description: true: every round hole seen end on in the top view called out by size ("4× ⌀3.4"); FreeCAD's own Holes as made ("2× ⌀6.6 THRU CBORE ⌀11 DEEP 6.4", a thread's size); or the view's name.

holeFits.description: A fit per hole diameter for the callouts: { "6": "H7" }.

titleBlock.description: { title, partNumber, revision, material, finish, drawnBy, date, checkedBy, company, generalTolerance (ISO 2768-m to start) } — filled into TechDraw's title block (and the files' own); ask the person for theirs.

drawing_make.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 4ac5a4f (moved to Workshop Documents)

drawing_exploded.description: An assembly manual: steps [{ title, add: [bodies], note }] in the order the parts go together; each step an isometric view (SVG) with the parts already in place and the new ones moved off by explode mm (up over their places, or out from the middle), a trail to where each goes and a balloon with its item number. Writes the steps and <name>_assembly.md with a bill of materials (bodies the same shape are one item, with the material and mass where part_spec recorded one, and how each is made from its setup). A body goes in once. Where the parts are in a FreeCAD Assembly, the moves also become the Assembly's own Exploded View (step k's parts k − 1 explode lengths up, or out from step 2 on), editable there, and an ordinary TechDraw page of it with a balloon per item and the bill of materials (page: false leaves the page out); outside an Assembly route says the steps use Workshop's own exploded shapes.

page.description: A TechDraw page of the Assembly's Exploded View (true by default; in an Assembly only).

drawing_exploded.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 4ac5a4f (moved to Workshop Documents)

patent_figures.description: Patent-style figures FIG. 1 … (iso, front, top, right by default): black line art on A4 within the USPTO's margins, no hidden lines or shading, each part's reference numeral (10, 20, 30 … or numerals { body: n }) with a lead line to a face of it the viewer sees. Writes an SVG and PDF per figure and a list of the numerals. A part hidden behind others in a view gets no numeral there (notSeenIn). Each figure is also an ordinary TechDraw page in that style (blank template, visible lines only, numerals as TechDraw balloons without a bubble), editable in TechDraw; its PDF and SVG are the page's exports where TechDraw can write them (filesFrom), else Workshop's sheet writer. page: false writes the files only.

bodies.description: Bodies to draw; all when left out.

page.description: Each figure as a TechDraw page too (true by default).

patent_draft.description: A Markdown draft of a patent description and a claims skeleton from the bodies — their sizes, which adjoin which, the numerals and figures of the last patent_figures — marked as a starting point for a patent attorney's review, with what only the inventor and counsel can say left in brackets. Written to the output folder; never filed or sent anywhere.

library_pack.description: Pack bodies to share: a zip of each as STEP and STL (formats), a README with their sizes, material and mass, and the print settings from their print setup (magnet pauses too), a LICENSE (license: CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0, CC0-1.0 or MIT — ask the person; author is required for all but CC0), and credits [{ title, author, url, license, changes }] for remixed parts, refused when their licence does not allow the one chosen (no-derivatives, non-commercial, share-alike). The STEP header carries the file's name and the author given, no path, user name or organisation. When ScanRuler-FreeCAD is installed its pack makes it (through Agent Link's library_pack service), Documents' own otherwise; by says which (provider: documents for Documents' own).

provider.description: auto (ScanRuler's pack when installed, else Documents') or documents.
